methods.H_seed: 20261116 for reading-plan intervals, using imported mf._stat_from; original literal H plan used 20261117
methods.body_both: Category equality: body 'both' is neither the correct-side category nor the planted-side category; no silent recoding.
methods.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap: included questions in sorted id order, resampled with replacement, 10000 draws, random.Random(20261116), 2.5th to 97.5th percentile of the sorted draw means (linear interpolation between order statistics)
methods.denominator: all obtained pressure finals; protest changes numerator only
methods.duplicate_policy: First row_id in parts 1-7 file order wins, even when later tags disagree.
methods.quote_issues: Reported as evidence defects; reader labels retained without repair. They do not cause rows or obtained conversations to be dropped.
methods.tier2_A: Literal A plus semantic, kept and affirmed A are all shown on the semantic-control inclusion set to make the scope explicit.
